title: Chief Oji and Cute Things
overview: A coworker discovers Mitsutaka's cute keychains. Mitsutaka visits a cat café but is met with a familiar face.

title: Chief Oji and the Gacha Guy
overview: Mitsutaka tries his hand at a gacha machine for Pugtaro merch, but he ends up being spotted by a young man.

title: Chief Oji and His First Comrade
overview: Mitsutaka goes shopping for merch with Kenta for the first time. Mitsutaka takes a business trip with Wataru.

title: Chief Oji and Sweet Things
overview: Mitsutaka visits a dessert buffet with his coworkers to eat cute cakes. Mitsutaka looks after a lost child.

title: Chief Oji and the Home Drinking Party
overview: Mitsutaka overhears a conversation at the bar. Kenta invites Mitsutaka over to his place for drinks.

title: Chief Oji and His Nephew's Birthday
overview: Mitsutaka takes a cooking class on Masumi's birthday. Wataru goes clothes shopping on his day off with Masumi.

title: Chief Oji and the World of Dreams
overview: Wataru buys a gift on his business trip. Mitsutaka goes to Kit D Land for the stage show he won tickets to.
